note: Read 2026-10-31 in the National Law Information Center (law.go.kr, the Ministry of Government Legislation), article by article. Majority: 민법 (Civil Act, in force text of 17 March 2026) art. 4 (wholly amended 7 March 2011): a person comes of age at nineteen. Marriage of a minor (art. 826-2, deemed of age) isn't held. Work: 근로기준법 (Labor Standards Act, in force 8 October 2026) art. 64(1): a person under fifteen, or under eighteen still at middle school, may not be employed, except one holding an employment permit (취직인허증) issued by the Minister of Employment and Labor; (2): issued only for a named occupation where compulsory schooling isn't hindered. Performers: Enforcement Decree art. 35(1): the permit is for those of thirteen to fourteen, but for taking part in an artistic performance a child under thirteen may receive it too; (3): the application is signed by the school principal and the parent or guardian, jointly with the employer. No lowest age. Service: 병역법 (Military Service Act, in force 2 October 2026) art. 3(1): Korean men must perform military service; women may serve only by volunteering; art. 8: men enter the preparatory service (병역준비역) at eighteen; art. 71(1): the duties of examination and of enlistment as an active-duty soldier end at thirty-six (thirty-eight for those who evaded, not held). Art. 18(2): an active-duty soldier serves two years in the Army, two years two months in the Navy (two years in the Marines), two years three months in the Air Force; art. 19(1)(3): the Minister of National Defense may shorten these by up to six months. The form's 18 months is the Army term as shortened (the Military Manpower Administration's guide, mma.go.kr, lists the Army and Marines at eighteen months, the Navy twenty, the Air Force twenty-one; it was found by a web search but its server refused the connection today, so that figure rests on the Act's power to shorten and is a reading to check). Not held: the examination at nineteen, social service and alternative service.

sources.said: 제64조(최저 연령과 취직인허증) ① 15세 미만인 사람( ... 고용노동부장관이 발급한 취직인허증(就職認許證)을 지닌 사람은 근로자로 사용할 수 있다.

sources.title: 근로기준법 시행령 제35조(취직인허증의 발급 등), 국가법령정보센터
sources.said: 에 따라 취직인허증을 받을 수 있는 자는 13세 이상 15세 미만인 자로 한다. 다만, 예술공연 참가를 위한 경우에는 13세 미만인 자도 취직인허증을 받을 수 있다.

sources.title: 병역법 제3조(병역의무), 국가법령정보센터
sources.said: 여성은 지원에 의하여 현역 및 예비역으로만 복무할 수 있다.
